race.comment: The Hayes' boys hold the key to the race with two leading chances. AKARI SPIRIT (1) eye-catching return over the unsuitable 1450m with a fast finishing second at Kilmore. Tackling a more suitable race this time from the good draw. Go close. RING OF FIRE (5) is due for a change of luck and looks to have strengthened over the break. Strong through the line with the 59kg when second over 1400m at Canberra. Gets his chance in this suitable contest. MASAKARI (4) blinkers come off deep into the prep and gets weight relief with the claim. Will roll forward and sure to be thereabouts again. SUNDAY VENDETTA (6) finished off strongly when beaten 0.8 lengths last time at Donald. Should be winding up late again. In the mix.
